text:
Star Ogden, accompany me
as she accompanied him; swarm around me
as stars did around Darío; think me
Orphic; accustom me
to being air around
those blind airplanes flying fast in
the proparoxytone New York
to Philadelphia; divine me
in a reversed Tarot with
Nefertitis bleeding beneath
the beauty of
the cloud of what will have been the skin
of hearing you, the
dangerous skin
of this Monday in Berlin with angels;
wherever
you may be, bring me into accord
with another, highest cithara of certainty
whose hypotenuse is God.

translation.title: Darío and More Darío
